# Rapid Garage Doors

> Garage door replacement, repair, opener installation and tune-ups for
> homeowners in Mississauga and across the Greater Toronto Area.
> Based in Mississauga, Ontario.

## What we do
- New garage doors: insulated steel, R-16.5 and up, standard 8x7 and 16x7
  sizes. Brands include Garaga, Wayne Dalton and Clopay. Every replacement
  includes new tracks, springs, hardware, weather seals and removal of the
  old door.
- Repairs: broken springs, snapped cables, off-track doors
- Garage door opener installation
- Aluminum capping for the door frame
- Tune-ups and the Rapid Care maintenance plan
- We do not offer emergency call-outs.

## Prices (installed)
- 8x7 door: $1,200 (no windows), $1,400 (2 windows), $1,600 (4 windows)
- 16x7 door: $1,850 (no windows), $2,050 (2 windows), $2,250 (4 windows)
- Opener installation: $100
- Aluminum capping: $300 (8x7), $450 (16x7)
- One-time tune-up: $139 + HST
- Rapid Care Plan: $199 + HST per year, two tune-ups (fall and spring),
  10% off spring, cable and off-track repairs, priority booking

## Timing
New door installs are usually done 3-5 days after booking.

## Where we work
Mississauga, Toronto, Brampton, Oakville, Milton, Vaughan, Markham,
Richmond Hill, Burlington, Ajax, Pickering, Whitby, Oshawa, Caledon.

## Hours
Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 7:00 PM
